rows.text: wins a **Rs 31.87 crore order** from the Integral Coach Factory, Chennai, to supply, install, and commission on-board equipment.
of the **3,024-unit CLW-II order from Chittaranjan Locomotive Works, 1,360 units are supplied**; it plans to dispatch the balance 1,664 by November 2026 and commission them by 5 February 2027.

rows.text: **wins an order valued at Rs 66.62 crore including GST from Integral Coach Factory, Chennai**, for **on-board KAVACH equipment** on EMU/MEMU rakes, to RDSO specification ~1.7% of mcap.
